items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Well, Coleman was married to a beautiful girl one time... I remember him distinctly saying this.

ctx.x: Tell us. Now you have us curious.

Well, Coleman was married to a beautiful girl one time, but he was more interested in music, and he never would come home except on the times of the jam session. His wife was named Gertie. And he would come in at seven, eight, nine in the morning, and he would stop off at a place called Big Johns, somewhere up in Harlem, and everything,

and he'd have his uniform on and Gertie would meet him at the door, and I remember him distinctly saying this. He said to the guys one night, 'You know, I got in nine o'clock in the morning, and Gertie met me at the door -- she called him Poopsie -- 'Hello Poopsie, how are you? Can I fix you something?' He said, he'd get mad. He would want her to be mad at him for being late. She'd never get mad. And it bothered him no end. So he thought that she didn't love him, one of those things, and they begin to become…
